summary.tldr: Keeps parental EI benefits and parental leave in place if a child dies, and ensures at least five weeks of benefits after the death.
what_it_does: Extends Employment Insurance parental benefits for a newborn or a child placed for adoption if the child dies during the benefit period, so the claimant can keep receiving benefits until at least five weeks after the week of death.
Applies the same rule to self-employed people receiving EI parental benefits, with a benefit-period extension if needed to reach five weeks after the child's death.
Limits any EI benefit-period extension for these cases to 104 weeks.
Lets the government set what information must be provided to the Employment Insurance Commission about these cases.
Keeps an employee's right to parental leave under the Canada Labour Code even if the child dies during the leave period.
summary.background: The bill amends the Employment Insurance Act and the Canada Labour Code. It deals with cases where a child dies during a period of parental benefits or parental leave.
